d: Long, wavy, crimson-red hair spills from beneath a dark grey wide-brimmed hat, framing a pale, featureless face of an ambiguous, adult age with narrow, glowing white eyes. A slender build is draped in a dark charcoal cape with red fringing and gold embroidery over a black high-collared suit, paired with brown leather boots and several crossing brown leather belts. The attire is accessorized with bright crimson gloves and a large, vertical beige leather tool roll strapped to the hip, containing various metallic blades and surgical instruments.
